d: Two Special Police Officers (SPOs) were found dead with bullet injuries in a remote forest in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kishtwar, a day after they went missing. The FIR attributes their killing to “unknown terrorists” and alleges the use of illegal firearms. Questions have emerged over their deployment in a remote forest, the weapons they carried and the circumstances surrounding their deaths. This report examines what the FIR says and the unanswered questions in the case.
